name: Integratec
description: Uruguayan online store selling notebooks, PCs, components and monitors, plus phones, wearables, audio, TV and video. Ships across Uruguay and offers in-store pickup in Montevideo.
description_es: Tienda online uruguaya de notebooks, PCs, componentes y monitores, además de celulares, wearables, audio, TV y video. Envía a todo el país y ofrece retiro en tienda en Montevideo.

ships_to.notes: Home FAQ says it ships to all of Uruguay; shipping cost shown before the purchase is confirmed.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup at the Tres Cruces store in Montevideo; payment on pickup accepted.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Robots.txt disallows /checkout and /api; browse catalog pages only. Product pages live under /productos/. Large items may carry a different shipping cost.

sources.supports: Home page FAQ: shipping to all of Uruguay, pickup in Tres Cruces, categories (notebooks, PCs, components, audio/TV/video, phones)
Policies page: shipping costs not included in price and shown before checkout ends; store hours
